_note: Pinned against kasm-session-runtime's v0.2.86-rc.1 tag (pre-release). This tag makes a declared shell tool's post: failure carry the command's output (apply: postcondition N (...) did not hold within ...; output: <out>), the same capped, redacted text a success returns, so a command that exits 0 and leaves no window still tells the model why (wine-assess post-failure-output request, 2026-09-14). The nonzero-exit path already did this. Two consumer notes: the output collector keeps the head, not the tail, so lead with the explanation; and evidence.tool_result_chars (default 300) caps the trace row separately from what the model sees. The sidebar (pkgs/kasm-ai-runtime-sidebar) is pinned to the same commit -- bump both together. Hashes computed by downloading both published objects (curl) and taking sha256-<base64 of the raw SHA-256 digest>, the same value nix's fixed-output check computes for a fetchurl. Re-pin the same way: download kasm-session-runtime-linux-<amd64|arm64>.<tag>.<short> and kasm-ai-runtime-sidebar.tar.gz.<tag>.<short>, hash, update.
